title: {{name}} the Goalkeeper
summary: 当门将做出关键扑救:球队守门员病了,主角临危守门很紧张,最后时刻对方射门时鼓起勇气扑出关键球守住球队。
text:
{{name}} loved soccer. But {{name}} never played in goal.

Today the team had a big match. But the goalkeeper was sick in bed. The coach looked at {{name}}.

"You must play in goal today," the coach said.

{{name}} felt scared. The net looked so big. "I must stop the ball," {{name}} thought. "I should be brave."

The whistle gave a loud sound. The match started. Both teams were quick and strong. The score stayed close. No team could win.

Time was almost up. Then a player on the other team got the ball. The player ran fast. Soon nobody was near the goal.

"They are going to score!" a friend yelled.

{{name}} stood ready. The player gave the ball a hard kick. The ball flew high to the net.

When the ball came, {{name}} jumped up. {{name}} reached far. {{name}} caught the ball! It was a great save!

The match was over. The team did not lose. The players ran to {{name}}.

"What a save!" they cheered. "You were so brave!"

{{name}} smiled. At first {{name}} felt scared. But {{name}} was brave, and {{name}} stopped the ball.

Every player is important. Now {{name}} is not afraid of the goal.
